items.title: Carnell Tate: Ruled out for Sunday's game
items.text:
Tate (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Omar Cooper: Will practice fully Friday
items.text:
Cooper (ankle) will be a full practice participant Friday, Eric Allen of the Jets' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Garrett Wilson: Nearing clearance for Sunday
items.text:
Wilson (concussion) has one more step to complete in concussion protocol, and Jets coach Aaron Glenn believes that will happen before Sunday's game against the Bills, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Will practice Friday
items.text:
Tuten (ankle/foot) will practice Friday, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Facing 6-to-10 week absence
items.text:
Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: In line to work through elbow issue Sunday
items.text:
Mahomes (elbow/knee) has had "limited swelling" and "limited pain" in his right (throwing) elbow in recent days, and he is in line to start Sunday's game against the Falcons, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
